source_text: Raab et omnis cognatio eius adunatur Israel — ecclesia ex gentibus. Signum in fenestra usque ad adventum — fides usque ad finem. Extra domum perit qui exierit.
pass_a_gloss: Rahab and all kinship her is-united to-Israel — church from nations. Sign in window until arrival — faith until end. Outside house perishes who shall-have-gone-out.
pass_b_english: Rahab and all her kin are joined to Israel — the church from the nations. The window-sign holds until the coming; faith must hold to the end. Whoever leaves the house perishes.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
